method: Independent model linguistic/source review of all 25 proposed lexical mappings, not native-human certification. Matched exact raw Spanish word/POS/sense hashes and selected lexical fields against pinned gzip, and exact MCR and WordNet lines against verified local source files. No production edits.

guards: Lexical whole words and exact selected meanings only. No new finite inflection, participle, adjective agreement, clitic composition or SE stripping authority.
Preserve selected contexts, source regional/register labels and roles despite conflicting POS/transitivity source tags.
GRISEAR overlaps the separately approved new-frame batch; deduplicate rather than claim a newly covered word.
The 118 deferred candidates remain unadjudicated; VENIRSE ejaculation evidence does not establish orgasm and remains deferred.
Runtime grammatical gender not independently certified. Model-derived English is not verbatim dictionary translation, native certification or Mexican-only usage.
Counts are lexical mappings, not new runtime coverage.
